rationale: Price is sitting at 83.4% of today's wide range after a large gap-down open on strong earnings, showing a significant intraday recovery from $97.55 to $106.59, but the last few 1-minute candles show a sharp drop to $106.10 followed by a partial bounce — momentum is choppy and indecisive near the 9-EMA ($107.13) and today's high ($108.40). The spread is manageable but the stock has already made its big move; entering long risks buying near resistance with unclear continuation, while entering short fights a strong earnings-driven recovery and positive news sentiment. With two working orders already consuming ~6% of buying power and a modest daily loss already on the books, the risk/reward here does not justify adding exposure.
